title: Meray Bhaiya Meray Ghazi Meray Pyaray Abbas
body:
Gir kay laashay pay yeh Shabir pukaray Abbas..
<<DIVIDER>>
Hashmi shan e taqudus kay hawalo ki qasam
Ghar main phelay huey purnoor ujalo ki qasam
Tum qamar ho meray bachay hain sitaray Abbas..
<<DIVIDER>>
Haq nay Mohsin ka badal aap ki soorat main diya
Aap ko Syeda Zahra nay kaha hai beta
Is liye kehtay hain bhaiya ho hamaray Abbas..
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis main shana kiya kertay thay Ali bhi aksar
Khaak aur khoon main lip tay huey aatay hain nazar
Wo jo hum nay teray gaysu thay sawaray Abbas..
<<DIVIDER>>
Meray Bhaiya Meray Ghazi Meray Pyaray Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Go kay halqoom sukhati hai tapish seenay ki
Phir bhi honto pay duayen hain teray jeenay ki
Muntazir pyas kay maray hain tumharay Abbas ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Kufa o sham ki raho ka Khuda hafiz hay
Meray khaimo ka ridaon ka Khuda hafiz hay
Too tay sub Sani e Zehra saharay Abbas..
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhri baar kalayjay say lagaon kaisay
Yeh tarap dil main liye lout kay jaon kaisay
Teer kis nay teray seenay pay hain maaray Abbas ..
